description.value: The Backyard is a locally beloved pub in the Valleycliffe neighbourhood of Squamish, voted best pub in the community five years running by locals. It offers pub grub, artisan pizzas, 13 beers on tap, hand-crafted cocktails, and non-alcoholic options alongside a patio and pool table. Touring cyclists passing through Squamish will find a relaxed, community-oriented stop with takeout and off-sales available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at backyardsquamish.com confirms this is an active pub at 1907 Maple Drive, Squamish, with a full menu, events schedule, and contact details. Takeout is explicitly offered ('snag some take-out or off-sales') and vegan/gluten-free options are stated ('Vegan and gluten free options available'). No bike-specific amenities (parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website, so those fields are null.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; phone 604-390-2226 sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.

The website displays two internally inconsistent sets of hours (the 'Opening Hours' section and the 'LOCATION & HOURS' footer section differ notably, e.g. Tuesday listed as open in one and closed in the other).
Contact email on website (info@backyardtap.ca) uses a different domain than the website URL (backyardsquamish.com) — may indicate a rebranding or secondary domain.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible pub in Squamish with confirmed takeout and food options; a practical stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'Vegan and gluten free options available' in the food section

wow_evidence: voted best pub in the community five years running by locals
